interval.definition:
n. a set containing all points (or all real numbers) between two given endpoints
n. the distance between things
n. the difference in pitch between two notes
interval.translation:
n. 间隔, 距离, 间歇, 间隙
[计] 时间间隔

interval arithmetic.translation: [计] 区间运算, 区间运算

interval mode.translation: [计] 间隔方式, 区间方式

interval timer.translation: [计] 区间计时器; 间隔时钟

intervale.definition:
n. A tract of low ground between hills, or along the banks
   of a stream, usually alluvial land, enriched by the overflowings of the
   river, or by fertilizing deposits of earth from the adjacent hills. Cf.
   Bottom, n., 7.

intervallic.translation: a. 间隔的, 间歇的, 幕间的, 工间的, 悬殊的

intervals.definition:
n. a definite length of time marked off by two instants
n. a set containing all points (or all real numbers) between two given endpoints
n. the distance between things
intervals.translation: n. [军事]间隔( interval的复数形式 ); 间隔时间; [数学]区间; （戏剧、电影或音乐会的）幕间休息

intervalve.translation: 级间的, 闸阀间的, (电子)管间的, 中间管的

intervence.translation: [法] 干预, 干涉, 介入

intervene.definition:
v. get involved, so as to alter or hinder an action, or through force or threat of force
v. be placed or located between other things or extend between spaces and events
v. occur between other event or between certain points of time
intervene.translation:
vi. 插入, 调停, 干涉
[经] 进场干预

intervened.translation: v. 阻碍( intervene的过去式和过去分词 ); 出面; 插嘴; 介于…之间

intervener.definition:
n. One who intervenes; especially (Law), a person who
   assumes a part in a suit between others.
intervener.translation: [法] 介入诉讼人, 调停者, 干涉者

interveners.definition:
plural of intervener
n. One who intervenes; especially (Law), a person who
   assumes a part in a suit between others.
interveners.translation: (intervener 的复数) [法] 介入诉讼人, 调停者, 干涉者

intervenes.definition:
v get involved, so as to alter or hinder an action, or through force or threat of force
v be placed or located between other things or extend between spaces and events
v occur between other event or between certain points of time
intervenes.translation: v. 阻碍( intervene的第三人称单数 ); 出面; 插嘴; 介于…之间

intervenient.definition: a. Being or coming between; intercedent; interposed.
intervenient.translation:
a. 介于其间的
[法] 介入的, 参加诉讼的, 调停的

intervenient party.translation: [法] 介入诉讼当事人, 参加诉讼当事人

intervening.definition: s. occurring or falling between events or points in time

intervening act.translation: [法] 干预行为, 介入行为

intervening bank.translation: [经] 介入银行, 插手银行

intervening damages.translation: [法] 延迟控诉引起的损害

intervening party.translation: [法] 介入诉讼当事人, 参与诉讼人

intervenor.definition: n. (law) a party who interposes in a pending proceeding
intervenor.translation: n. 干涉者, 介入者, 调停者

intervent.definition: v. t. To thwart; to obstruct.

intervention.definition:
n. the act of intervening (as to mediate a dispute, etc.)
n. a policy of intervening in the affairs of other countries
n. (law) a proceeding that permits a person to enter into a lawsuit already in progress; admission of person not an original party to the suit so that person can protect some right or interest that is allegedly affected by the proceedings
intervention.translation:
n. 插入, 介入, 调停
[经] 干预

intervention by right.translation: [法] 依据权利的干涉, 依权干预

interventionist.translation:
n. 干涉主义者
a. 干涉主义的

interventionists.translation:
(interventionist 的复数) n. 干涉主义者
a. 干涉主义的

interventions.definition:
n. the act of intervening (as to mediate a dispute, etc.)
n. a policy of intervening in the affairs of other countries
n. the act or fact of interposing one thing between or among others
interventions.translation: n. 介入, 干涉, 干预( intervention的复数形式 )

interventricular.definition:
a. Between the ventricles; as, the interventricular
   partition of the heart.

intervertebral.definition: a. pertaining to the space between two vertebrae
intervertebral.translation:
a. 椎骨间的, 脊椎骨间的
[医] 椎[骨]间的

intervertebral cartilages.translation: [医] 椎间盘(椎间纤维软骨)

interview.definition:
n. the questioning of a person (or a conversation in which information is elicited); often conducted by journalists
v. conduct an interview in television, newspaper, and radio reporting
v. discuss formally with (somebody) for the purpose of an evaluation
v. go for an interview in the hope of being hired
interview.translation:
n. 面谈, 访问, 接见, 面试
vt. 接见, 对...进行面谈(试)

interview for a job.translation: 招工面试,为找工作而接受的面试

interviewed.definition:
v conduct an interview in television, newspaper, and radio reporting
v discuss formally with (somebody) for the purpose of an evaluation
v go for an interview in the hope of being hired
interviewed.translation: v. 面试( interview的过去式和过去分词 ); 访问; 会见; （私下）提问

interviewee.definition: n. a person who is interviewed
interviewee.translation: n. 被接见者, 被采访者, 被面试者

interviewees.definition: n. a person who is interviewed
interviewees.translation: n. 接受面谈者, 被接见者( interviewee的复数形式 )

interviewer.definition: n. a person who conducts an interview
interviewer.translation: n. 会见者, 面谈者, 进行面试者

interviewers.definition: n. a person who conducts an interview
interviewers.translation: n. 主持面谈者, 接见者, 采访者( interviewer的复数形式 )

interviewing.definition:
v conduct an interview in television, newspaper, and radio reporting
v discuss formally with (somebody) for the purpose of an evaluation
v go for an interview in the hope of being hired
interviewing.translation: vi. 面试；参加面试（interview的ing形式）

interviews.definition:
n the questioning of a person (or a conversation in which information is elicited); often conducted by journalists
n a conference (usually with someone important)
v conduct an interview in television, newspaper, and radio reporting
v discuss formally with (somebody) for the purpose of an evaluation
v go for an interview in the hope of being hired
interviews.translation:
n. 接见( interview的名词复数 ); 采访; 面谈; 会谈
v. 面试( interview的第三人称单数 ); 访问; 会见; （私下）提问

intervisible.definition:
a. Mutually visible, or in sight, the one from the
   other, as stations.

intervision.translation: n. 东欧八国间的电视联播网

intervital.translation: a. 在生命与生命之间的

intervolution.definition:
n. The state of being intervolved or coiled up; a
   convolution; as, the intervolutions of a snake.
intervolution.translation: 被缠绕或盘绕的状态或事实

intervolve.definition:
v. t. To involve one within another; to twist or coil
   together.
intervolve.translation: v. 互卷, 卷合, 互相牵连

intervolved.translation: v. 互卷, 卷合, 互相牵连( intervolve的过去式和过去分词 )

intervolving.definition: p. pr. & vb. n. of Intervolve
intervolving.translation: v. 互卷, 卷合, 互相牵连( intervolve的现在分词 )
